sys_di_key.description:
Analyze the document and locate the section titled "5(C) PROFIT & LOSS". From this section, extract the latest available financial year values for: - "Total Revenue" - "Cost of Materials Consumed" - "Purchases of Stock in Trade"
Calculate Gross Profit Margin (%) using the formula:
Gross Profit Margin (%) = ((Total Revenue - (Cost of Materials Consumed + Purchases of Stock in Trade)) / Total Revenue) * 100
Rules: 1. Look only inside the "5(C) PROFIT & LOSS" section. 2. Use values from the latest financial year column only. 3. If "Purchases of Stock in Trade" is blank or "-", treat it as 0. 4. Return only the calculated Gross Profit Margin (%) value. 5. Round the result to 2 decimal places. 6. Do not extract values from: - EBITDA % - PAT Margins (%) - Revenue Growth (%) 7. If Total Revenue is missing or 0, return "NA". 8. Output must contain only the calculated percentage value without extra text.
sys_di_key.name: Gross Profit %
